text1: A compact ballistic cannon firing proximity-fused fragmentation rounds. Favored by The Directory for cheap and reliable point defense, the Miniflakker saturates the local space with jagged shrapnel, effectively neutralizing incoming ordnance and light fighter craft.

The standard Directory medium linear induction autocannon. It fires three-round bursts of dense kinetic slugs using an electromagnetic coil array. Though its power demands are modest compared to advanced railguns, its reliable shield-breaking capability makes it a staple of standard fleet engagements.

An upscaled variant of the standard coilgun, the heavy coilgun features significantly enlarged accelerator coils. This increases muzzle velocity and effective range dramatically, providing capital ships and cruisers with a punishing kinetic barrage capable of fracturing shields at a distance.

This medium electromagnetic flak projector hurls large, magnetically charged fragmentation shells. Upon proximity detonation, the shells release a dense cloud of energized shrapnel. It serves as a robust defense grid component for larger Directory vessels.

A dual-mounted magnetic flak system that effectively doubles the defensive screen of its host vessel. By utilizing synchronized firing patterns, it creates overlapping fields of fragmentation clouds, forming an impassable barrier for hostile strike craft and missiles.

A rapid-fire kinetic machine gun infamous for its distinct tracer fire. While the lightweight rounds struggle to penetrate heavy armor, their sheer volume quickly overwhelms energy shielding and reliably strips exposed weapon mounts.

A twin-linked configuration of the Stinger machine gun. Improved ammunition feeds and a heavier mounting platform allow for extended sustained fire, rendering it an exceptional shield-suppression tool in close-quarters brawls.

A high-performance magnetic railgun designed for long-range engagement. The Épée accelerates ferrous slugs to hypervelocity speeds via intense induction heating. While it excels at piercing shields and cracking armor, it requires significant cool-down periods between firing cycles.

This large twin railgun mount integrates two Épée mass drivers into a stabilized housing. Advanced recoil dampening and superior fire control systems offer a modest range extension, providing capital ships with a devastating long-range shield-breaking asset.

A heavy ballistic cannon of traditional but highly refined design. The Greave Cannon sacrifices the elegance of electromagnetic acceleration for sheer explosive force, delivering massive payloads that can cripple enemy armor plating with a single direct hit.

A versatile small-caliber ballistic weapon. Firing high-density rounds at a steady cadence, the Autogun provides dependable fire support for frigates and fighters, balancing kinetic output with reasonable resource demands.

A medium energy projector that utilizes magnetic containment fields to stream reactive positrons at the target. Upon contact, the resulting antimatter annihilation releases tremendous thermal energy, making it an excellent tool for melting through heavy armor.

A scaled-up positron weapon designed for heavy hardpoints. It projects a significantly denser stream of antimatter particles, capable of breaching capital-grade armor systems and overwhelming heavy shielding through sheer energy transfer.

The pinnacle of The Directory's positron weaponry. The Positron Mauler discharges condensed packets of antimatter with explosive force, causing catastrophic structural failure on impact. Its immense power requirements relegate it to dedicated strike roles.

A medium burst laser driven by an integrated gigawatt-range capacitor bank. It discharges a concentrated pulse of coherent light, excelling in rapid-attack doctrines. However, the weapon requires a brief recovery phase to recharge its capacitors after a sustained burst.

A miniaturized continuous-beam laser tuned specifically for tracking and destroying incoming missiles. Its reliable targeting algorithms and near-instantaneous beam travel time make it a ubiquitous point defense asset.

A compact microwave amplification weapon. The Tactical Maser emits a focused, high-energy RF beam that excels at disrupting electronics and searing through light armor, offering exceptional utility for frontline skirmishers.

The Zone Defense Maser is a low-energy microwave emitter calibrated to intercept ordnance. While it lacks the raw thermal output to threaten major warships, its RF discharge wreaks havoc on the guidance systems of inbound missiles.

A downsized variant of the Zone Defense Maser, optimized for deployment on automated drones and light fighters. It provides essential missile interception capabilities without drawing excessive power from diminutive drone reactors.

A heavy hydrogen maser boasting tremendous thermal output. Though highly demanding on the host vessel's reactor, its withering radio-frequency beam easily boils away advanced armor composites and overloads enemy avionics.

A massive defensive maser installation reserved for capital ships and stations. It projects a wide-band RF interference field that neutralizes sprawling missile barrages and deters enemy bomber wings with blistering thermal radiation.

A large array of synchronized laser emitters. By converging multiple beams onto a single focal point, this weapon achieves remarkable armor-penetration capability over extended distances, serving as a primary capital ship battery.

An advanced energy weapon utilizing a phased emitter grid. This allows the beam to adjust its frequency and focal length on the fly, offering unparalleled precision and consistent damage projection across varying engagement ranges.

A medium external rack mounting intermediate-range heatseeking missiles. The Alouette prioritizes acceleration over sustained flight, striking with a high-voltage electromagnetic warhead designed to arc across shields and paralyze enemy subsystems.

A compact pod configuration for the Alouette missile system. This internalized mount provides a larger reserve magazine, allowing for sustained deployment of these high-acceleration EMP munitions in protracted engagements.

A medium external rack for the Hatf Standoff-Range Attack Munition. Lacking guidance, these rockets are packed with high-energy solid propellant, granting them extreme acceleration and a high-yield explosive payload to crush heavy armor.

A small internal pod launcher for Hatf unguided rockets. It offers a deeper magazine than simple external racks, ensuring a steady supply of high-acceleration explosive munitions for dedicated strike craft.

A medium mounting for the Ra'ad rocket. Based on the Hatf spaceframe, the Ra'ad is equipped with a devastating electromagnetic warhead. Its EMP payload arcs across shields to cripple vital electrical subsystems.
A small pod launcher firing Ra'ad EMP rockets in a clustered formation. Additional internal storage allows multiple reloads, providing sustained anti-subsystem pressure during intense firefights.
A three-cell counter-missile launcher. It fires rapid-response interceptors designed to acquire and eliminate incoming heavy ordnance before they reach the fleet's defensive perimeter.

An unorthodox kinetic weapon that accelerates a mass of ferrous gravel through a powerful electromagnetic coil. At close range, this dense cloud of hypervelocity shrapnel shreds exposed hull plating and lightly armored targets.

A massive energy projector firing a sustained, corrosive thermal beam. The Alkahest destabilizes armor composites and overwhelms shielding with brute force. Unstable positron reactions within the beam occasionally trigger critical localized explosions.

A miniaturized Alkahest beam adapted for heavy fighters. Despite the reduced power output, it retains the distinctive armor-destabilizing properties of its capital-grade counterpart, making these fighters a severe threat to major warships.

An integrated pod mounting dual Alkahest beam emitters. This configuration is optimized for sustained engagement, utilizing automated cooling systems to maintain the blistering, armor-dissolving output over long durations.

A specialized energy weapon developed exclusively for Directory fighter craft. It delivers rapid, concentrated pulses of energy designed to efficiently strip shielding and disable opposing interceptors in chaotic dogfights.

An integrated, built-in defensive gun turret. Primarily designed to deter incoming fighters and munitions, these concealed batteries deploy rapidly to protect vital hull segments when the primary defensive grid is overwhelmed.
A passive thermal regulation vent array, essential for dissipating the immense heat generated by The Directory's advanced electromagnetic weapon systems. Crucial for prolonged operational stability.

A dedicated AWACS and sensor platform, the Adept-class frigate serves as the nerve center for Directory patrol groups. Equipped with a powerful multi-mode electronically-scanned array (MESA) radar, it enhances the targeting and detection capabilities of allied vessels. While lightly armed, its strategic value in providing early warning and tactical oversight is immeasurable.

The Chevalier-class destroyer is a versatile and nimble combatant favored by Directory commanders for aggressive maneuvers. Balancing robust armor with an adaptable weapon grid, it performs exceptionally well both as a rapid-response element in major fleet actions and as the vanguard of independent task forces.

A heavy frigate designed for relentless assault, the Lancier features an aggressive ballistic loadout and a reinforced shield emitter. Distinguishing itself from standard frigates, it hosts a dedicated drone bay, allowing it to project localized fighter cover and adapt to rapidly changing tactical scenarios.

The Damascus-class picket frigate is the quintessential patrol vessel of The Directory. Prioritizing sensory equipment and mobility over heavy armor, it excels in securing perimeters, intercepting smugglers, and providing vital flank security during major fleet engagements.

A rugged, reliable light freighter commonly found traversing the Sector's trade lanes. The Mistral compensates for its modest cargo capacity with highly modular internals, exceptional ease of maintenance, and sufficient defensive armaments to deter opportunistic pirates.

A militarized fleet tanker, the Sommelier-class provides vital logistical support for long-range Directory deployments. Featuring a heavily reinforced hull and a compact flight deck for underway replenishment and fighter rearmament, its tactical utility comes at the cost of remarkably sluggish drive performance.

A fast, light fleet carrier tailored for rapid strike operations. The Dupleix-class sacrifices heavy armor and bulk for speed, utilizing its single spacious flight deck to launch precision bomber strikes and fighter screens before retreating to the safety of the backline.

A specialized missile destroyer, the Hallebarde is designed to deliver overwhelming long-range fire support. Built around advanced targeting computers and expansive missile magazines, it acts as a dedicated bombardment platform, capable of breaking defensive lines from well beyond retaliation range.

An advanced trans-atmospheric interceptor utilized extensively by The Directory. Armed with a precision maser and boasting exceptional thrust-to-weight ratios, the Djinn is beloved by its pilots for its nimble handling and surprising durability in chaotic dogfights.

A formidable heavy fighter designed to crack major warships. The Ifrit sacrifices the agility of interceptors for dense armor plating and heavy assault weaponry. It operates as the tip of the spear in carrier strikes, reliably punching holes in enemy defensive lines.

A networked array of multi-mode electronically scanned array (MESA) radars and LADAR rangefinders. When synchronized with fleet communication systems, it dramatically enhances the targeting algorithms and sensor resolution of all allied spacecraft in the vicinity.

text3: Temporarily boosts ship acceleration and turn rate.

text1: An experimental and highly dangerous drive modification. The system injects a catalyzed beam of antiprotons directly into the main drive stream, mimicking the performance of a sustained burn without diverting flux. The resulting thermal stress presents a critical risk of engine failure.
text3: Provides sustained burn capabilities at massive risk of engine flameout.
